note_company: Superbet (multi-brand sports betting/casino group: Superbet RO/RS/PL/GR/BR, Napoleon BE casino/dice/games/sports, LuckyDays, SpinAway)
key_takeover_note: SUBDOMAIN TAKEOVER IS EXPLICITLY BOUNTY-ELIGIBLE ($500 flat unless additional impact). S3-bucket takeovers are TEMPORARILY out of scope. This makes takeover the primary target here -- 13 multi-brand acquired wildcards = high odds of dangling DNS. Our takeover_scanner + verify_takeover_candidates pipeline is the right tool. Employee working-credentials leak = $250.
critical_constraints: MUST send 'User-Agent: hackerone' header on ALL automated tools/scripts -- their SOC blocks requests without it. Set via BBHUNT_AUTH_HEADERS.
Max 50 requests/second -- keep BB_RATE_LIMIT <= 50 (using 40 to be safe).
NO scanners (Nessus, Acunetix, etc.) -- vulns found by scanners are NOT rewarded. Skip nuclei full-scan; our value is manual-verified takeover/DNS/config, not scanner output.
ALL LOGIN services are OUT OF SCOPE. No brute-force on login = instant ban. We do neither (recon-only, no auth).
IDOR/BAC on SOCIAL functionality is out of scope.
Do not discuss vulnerabilities outside the program (confidentiality) -- scope config in memory/ (public info), findings detail in .private/.
policy_notes: Public program. Main app testing (superbet.ro/magicjackpot.ro) needs a Romanian account+VPN -- not doing (no-account rule, recon-only).
3rd-party vulns generally not rewarded -- report upstream. Relevant since multi-brand infra has lots of shared 3rd-party components.

Out of scope also: clickjacking (no sensitive action), CSRF unauth, MITM, known-vuln-libs w/o PoC, CSV injection, SSL/TLS best-practice, DoS, content spoofing, rate-limit on non-auth, missing headers/CSP/cookie flags, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, version/banner disclosure, open redirect w/o impact, user/email enum, self-XSS, CORS w/o PoC, HTTP-only login page.
SLA: first response 1 business day, triage 2, bounty 14 -- responsive program.
